A few things to know

Before we
get started.

What types of interiors do you design?

CUBE offers residential interiors, commercial spaces, modular kitchens, and renovation & consultation. Contact the team to discuss your requirements.

Can I enquire about just a kitchen or renovation?

Yes. Modular kitchens and renovation & consultation are among our services. Tell us which part of your space you want to improve.

Where can I reach your team?

CUBE has branches in Ulikkal and Kannur, Kerala. Call +91 75111 72888 or +91 79074 06307 to discuss your project or arrange a visit.

What should I include in my enquiry?

Share your name, phone number, project location and the service you need. If available, mention your approximate area, budget range and preferred timeline.
